assessment_author: assistant-authored implementation evidence; no new human scores

raw_geography_contract.known: Nonblank value, selected span IDs, empty reason
raw_geography_contract.unresolved: Explicit empty value/evidence and a nonblank reason; not substituted for an omitted field

checks: Selected component span when supported facts exist
provenance.limit: These checks establish provenance, not semantic classification of a place or exhaustive proof of absence

unresolved_behavior.warning: Geographic scope is unresolved for this draft; verify the cited sources before approval.
unresolved_behavior.raw_reason: Retained in diagnostic evidence; not echoed as arbitrary product instructions
unresolved_behavior.missing_answer_and_unknown_location: Distinct states; existing no-information message remains unchanged

offline_validation.model_quality_limit: Fixed responses and pure contract checks; not a real LLM-quality measurement

requirement_evidence.requirement: Required geography, omission not silently defaulted
requirement_evidence.evidence: Emitted schema and archived raw-response rejection, plus omission regressions
Resolved span ID/source ID/hash/offset/quotation assertions and synthetic known example
State-validation tests and truly unlocated synthetic passage; fixed unknown cases retain supported output
244 passing offline tests; zero new model/NeMo/Ragas calls

requirement_evidence.requirement: Preserve partial facts and avoid name guessing
requirement_evidence.evidence: Partial-answer integration tests and anonymous/Atlas/IEA text cases

requirement_evidence.requirement: Human review and usage stop conditions
requirement_evidence.evidence: No new actual draft awaits review; usage checked before long steps; saved handoff identifies future checkpoints

manual_review.reason: No new actual analyst drafts or empirical quality claims
required_later: Actual revised drafts: source support, geographic classification, completeness, causes, dates/measures/scenarios
Any unresolved geography warning: owner verifies sources before approving
External task sessions before independent-usefulness claims

remaining_validation: Actual local model compliance with the new object contract is unverified. Use new frozen fixtures and a new bounded experiment; never restart old stopped directories.
project_readiness: Not production-qualified; prior failed quality gates retain their status
